name: Reel
text: Adopt **pre-approved model thresholds** set jointly by Engineering and Data Prot. This guarantees consistent, auditable standards without reinventing criteria for every task, cutting review cycles by 30%. The trade-off is slower adaptation to edge cases, but that’s acceptable since the thresholds are pre-approved—meaning the cost of flexibility is outweighed by the gain in speed and reliability.

name: Scriv
text: Pre-approved thresholds shift risk from *inconsistency* to *rigidity*—edge cases pile up until the model’s logic becomes a black box that fails silently. A better alternative: set *default* thresholds with a fast-track override path for Data Protection to challenge outliers, then measure whether review cycles actually shrink. Settle it by tracking how often overrides happen and whether they correlate with higher error rates.
